data.title: 砂狼白子 · 破晓骑行前的狼耳轻抖
data.action: 坐在床边弯腰系着运动短袜的脚踝带，白狼耳朵在银发间机敏地转动，单手拉了拉吊带，回头用毫无波澜却无比专注的浅蓝眼眸看着老师。

data.lighting: 阿拜多斯初升的沙漠晨曦穿透玻璃，将纯白银发与白皙肌肤照耀得如同初雪发亮
data.mood: 冷酷干练中带着极度直球的依恋，晨曦中健美无暇的少女身姿
data.description: 阿拜多斯对策委员会活动室，靠墙停放着保养得一尘不染的公路自行车。坐在床边弯腰系着运动短袜的脚踝带，白狼耳朵在银发间机敏地转动，单手拉了拉吊带，回头用毫无波澜却无比专注的浅蓝眼眸看着老师。 她微微抬眸轻语——“老师，起得真早。今天的晨间骑行训练……要和我一起去吗？我会放慢速度等你的。”
data.promptProse: Inside the Abydos Countermeasures Committee room at 5 AM with her spotless road bicycle leaning against the wall, Shiroko sits on the bench edge in her snug grey-and-cyan stretch athletic racerback camisole and boyleg workout shorts. Leaning slightly forward while adjusting a shoulder strap before her morning ride, she looks back toward the viewer with calm, focused eyes. Clear amber dawn light pours through the wide windows from the waking desert horizon.
data.animaCaption: Seated inside the Abydos clubroom beside her road bicycle in a grey-and-cyan athletic racerback camisole and boyleg shorts, Shiroko tugs lightly at one strap and looks back calmly toward the viewer. Crisp golden dawn light floods in from the desert horizon.
data.nsfwProse: She wears a form-fitting light-grey and cyan-blue stretch athletic racerback camisole paired with snug boyleg workout shorts.
